profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Capital One

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working as principal associate for a team which is developing and maintaining 
1. A data pipeline which collects different metrics from a cloud based data lake.
2. Replication monitoring which observes and notifies any errors during replication of objects in the datalake.
3. An application which provides delete and restore functions for the datasets on data lake.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Architected and developed an edge computing software which connects Siemens FS20M fire panel to cloud, allowing users to manage it remotely.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as a senior engineer/lead to develop multiple internal tools like employee, time management and performance tracking software. Also architected/developed a shipping calculator which calculates shipping cost on the webstaurantstore website based on the package size, destination, shipping type etc and suggests best quote to the customer.

positions.title: Software developer
positions.description:
Worked as a contractor to help them achieve short term goals. Important achievements here were 
1. Writing a unit test framework which autogenerated tests from the code. 
2. Proof of concept to connect progress(database) based backend with modern angular based frontend.

positions.title: Associate Consultant
positions.description:
Worked as an engineer to develop Mass Notification System. This was a huge project and i got an opportunity to work in all layers of the application including database, business logic, infrastructure, device drivers and user interface development. Some of the achievements from this period were
1. Developed a data access layer library which  provided access to a sql server and PVSS(Siemens proprietary) database.
2. Developed a custom transport layer to enable transactions in WCF duplex communication.
3. Developed device drivers for SMS gateway, Media controller.
4. Led the user interface team.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed Video Management Software which connects to DVR and streams video from multiple cameras.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on developing a web tool for a real estate company.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed an automated testing framework using Ruby Scripting
Defect fixing and feature enhancement for a web application firewall (ISAPI application) using Visual C++.
Performed penetration testing for web applications
Configuring Continuous Integration system using Cruisecontrol.NET

positions.title: Trainee Software Developer
positions.description: Implemented a network audit tool in a team of four which was responsible to scanning network and generating reports using C#.NET ,SQL Server , Crystal Reports, XML, XSL, XSLT.
